name: coll_tp8_colr3_a-r3-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen TP8 compute-die collective (qfd_io_collective) data column leaf, pin-registered WT 3 (qwen-coll-io r2 10-14, el1014-qwen-coll-io.log). 14 x 32x128 macros (same plan as the closed WT 2 leaf), 244.08 x 237.6, cap M5, recipe 2 (pin flops at pins, hold pads, halo 5.4) + macro-edge M5 guard. Composition benches: 8-rank TP8 golden ((P0+P1)+P2)+P3 with Pp = die0+die1, exact unit 9 cases + production 3 cases (WT 3, DEPTH 64 engine, LQ/TQ 128); mutants OT_TP8_MUT_OWNER / OT_TP8_MUT_GATHER / OT_TP8R_MUT_SEAM / OT_TP8R3_MUT_SKEW (s_lo/s_hi pin flop bypassed: slices see words one edge early) all fail.

structural_change: NEW master (WT 3) replacing the CLOSED WT 2 leaf ot_coll_tp8_col_tile_r, which FAILS the native pin audit (TT phi-R, R 312.2: c_pop/c_takel/c_sel/c_push capture 385-459 ps, hv launch 346, s_lo/s_hi launch 418 = combinational head muxes; 1,038 pins over 220/190): the parent controller read hv from the meta leaf and returned c_pop in the same edge (346 + logic + 458 > 833 before wire), so no cluster of WT 2 leaves can close. ot_coll_tp8_col_tile_r3 lands EVERY input (control and data) in a pin flop ahead of the unchanged WT 2 column core and drives s_lo/s_hi from pin flops; the controller reads only the metadata column, now flat beside it in the cluster glue (ot_coll_tp8_col_core MEM 2). The leaf is an exact replica of the WT 2 column one edge late (s_lo/s_hi two); the parent pairs each leaf output with its valid/meta delayed by the same edge. 4 data leaves per die (the meta column is no longer a leaf).
